newsitem.title: USA: UN-Iraq panel approves rules to speed aid delivery.
newsitem.headline: UN-Iraq panel approves rules to speed aid delivery.

text.p: The U.N. sanctions committee on Iraq has adopted four new technical procedures aimed at speeding delivery of food and medicine to Iraqis under the oil-for-food accord, the United Nations said Thursday.

Despite the fact Iraq has been allowed to sell oil under the accord since December 10, there have been no corresponding food or medicine imports to needy Iraqis, a situation that has raised the ire of Baghdad in recent weeks.
On Monday, Iraqi Foreign Minister Mohammed Saeed al-Sahaf told Reuters the sluggish pace of processing contracts was "unbelievable," and suggested changes to the head of sanctions
